links.outcome: LLM scoring reliability and discrepancies before versus after public release of the model
links.effect: After public release, reliability decreased notably (ICC = -0.046 for BVMT-R Trial 3) and average scoring discrepancies rose (SDMT from 0.05 to 6.79).
links.quote: After ChatGPT-4.5 was publicly released, reliability decreased notably (e.g. ICC = -0.046 for BVMT-R Trial 3), and average scoring discrepancies per test increased (e.g. SDMT = 6.79).

links.outcome: Change in LLM scoring performance after model update/release
links.effect: Reliability fell and scoring discrepancies increased after the public release version replaced the early-access model (SDMT discrepancy 0.05 to 6.79).
links.quote: After ChatGPT-4.5 was publicly released, reliability decreased notably (e.g. ICC = -0.046 for BVMT-R Trial 3), and average scoring discrepancies per test increased (e.g. SDMT = 6.79).

unlisted_practices: LLM automated scoring of neuropsychological assessment protocols compared against dual human raters with blinded third-rater adjudication

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the feasibility and inter-rater reliability of multimodal ChatGPT-4.5 vs human raters in scoring deidentified cognitive assessment protocols (BICAMS).
